sam (eng): Posted the postmortem for the 2026-03-21 serving incident: https://redwood-internal/docs/rca/1917200000. Quick summary: simultaneous preemptions during scale-in exposed a KV cache cold-start bug and generated a retry storm that cascaded to fallbacks. No data exfiltration. Impact window ~18m.
lisa (sre): thanks sam. Action items I highlighted: autoscaler guardrail, retry-storm alert, and a dedicated canary for the autoscaler change. Owners and dates are in the doc.
sam (eng): owners: runtime -> autoscaler guardrail (tom), infra -> fallback priority (lisa), qa -> synthetic preemption tests (mina).
tom (prod): can we prioritize the customer follow-up template? mina can you draft a short note for affected customers?
mina (support): drafting now, will paste into the doc and flag any tickets that need escalation.
dev-bot: calendar event created: "Postmortem follow-up: serving incident" 2026-03-24 17:00 UTC.
lisa (sre): scheduling weekly checkpoints until items are resolved. Please update status in the doc so we can close the loop.
sam (eng): thanks all, closing thread — reopen if anything urgent. :white_check_mark:
